hardware: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S
purpose: Common-KV-precision diagnostic for the K_S 512-context gate: compare both saved arms against the saved llama.cpp BF16-KV teacher (matching hipEngine's BF16 KV storage) instead of the default F16-KV teacher. Labeled diagnostic alongside the normative F16-KV gate (benchmarks/results/2026-09-08-zbook-ud-ks-context512-teacher-gate-corrected.json); teacher selection is not a gate criterion and neither result is promoted on this basis.
method: Existing captures, no new GPU work. The BF16-KV teacher was captured with the stale K_M-history input, so prompt 7 (general_ja_explain) steps 5-8 are excluded: 158 of 162 rows. Prompt 2's stale continuation index 8 is dropped by the tokenwise harness and never consumed. Recapture of the four stale BF16-KV rows is optional follow-up; none of the excluded rows are worst-case candidates.

arms_vs_bf16kv_teacher.gates: same thresholds as the normative gate (mean<=0.001, p95<=0.005, p99<=0.02, max<=0.05, top1>=0.99)
arms_vs_bf16kv_teacher.expanded_verdict: passes all five gates on the valid rows
arms_vs_bf16kv_teacher.raw_verdict: passes mean/p95/p99/max; top-1 156/158 = 98.73% misses the 0.99 threshold by one flip

teacher_kv_precision_floor.description: llama.cpp F16-KV vs BF16-KV teacher on the same 158 rows: the KL the KV-precision choice alone creates

interpretation: Against the KV-matched teacher both arms drop under the mean gate (0.0009 vs 0.00104 against the F16-KV teacher), so a substantial part of the normative gate's mean excess is the hipEngine-BF16-KV vs teacher-F16-KV precision mismatch, not projection arithmetic. The raw IQ2_XS arm still shows a real tail/top-1 deficit relative to the expanded arm: worst row heldout_code_rate_limiter step 1 KL 0.030749 (the same row already flagged as the K_M raw Q5/Q6 arm's one above-threshold row in the 2026-09-07 common-KV artifact), and top-1 misses at code_lru_cache step 8 and the known general_ja_explain step 4. The expanded arm's mean remains slightly better (0.000895 vs 0.000922).
next: Localize heldout_code_rate_limiter step 1 (raw arm) with layer-boundary captures plus a control prompt; examine recurrent state, projection-input rounding, and residual accumulation under identical operation inputs. K_M evidence already established a Q8_1-vs-BF16 activation difference without proving a faulty projection.

commands.bf16kv_teacher: /tmp/ud-llama-context512-S-bf16kv.f32 (captured 2026-09-08 with stale input for prompt 7 steps 5-8)
